visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a clean, modern kitchen with bright natural light coming from a large window. A man in a white t-shirt and green pants stands near a kitchen island, looking towards the camera. The background shows a living area with a woman sitting at a desk using a laptop. (2) The camera transitions to a sequence of product close-ups held by the man's hands. First, a vacuum-sealed pack of Thomas Meat pork slices, then a blue box of 'High Quality Araucana Eggs' from Hongsheng Livestock Farm, and finally a plastic bag of 'Sun Make' green vegetables from PX Mart. (3) The man cracks several eggs with orange yolks into a green ceramic bowl featuring a cartoon frog. He moves to a yellow cutting board, slicing the ends off green leafy vegetables and baby corn with a sharp metal knife. His hands are adorned with gold rings. (4) He places the baby corn into a black Philips air fryer and slides the drawer shut. On a Sakura gas stove, he turns a knob to ignite a flame under a white pan. He pours the eggs into the pan and stir-fries the vegetables in a separate pot using a black spatula. (5) The man sears the pork slices in a hot pan, showing them browning and releasing steam. He seasons them with garlic powder from a green container. He then slices the cooked meat on the cutting board. (6) He plates the food, carefully arranging the stir-fried greens, fried eggs, and sliced pork onto two plates. He brings a plate to the woman at the desk, who is dressed in a blue shirt. She smiles and begins to eat while he watches. (7) The video concludes with a black screen and white text in the center.
